decisions.reason: As a full aloe vera line presented on its own page, Product A carries the firm's largest investment and most visible public commitment, and it fits the announced path of continued natural-care innovation, so management would persist and attribute any weak early sales to the launch period.

The hyaluronic serum sits close to the established facial care range and was launched only recently, so modest results can still be read as temporary, and the low cost of keeping it in a small-batch portfolio favors retaining it.

A cleansing milk is a basic complement to the firm's facial care offer that cost little to develop, and the sunk effort plus its fit with the firm's established positioning lead management to keep it rather than admit a misstep after one year.
